audit_type: independent endpoint audit of the locked payment-certified profile

interval.source: held-out per-job measured-to-predicted energy ratio q01 and q99

endpoint_dominance_theorem: For each fixed profile, the optimal linear N-1 SCED value is convex in a scalar load-conversion factor; its worst-case value on a closed interval is attained at an endpoint. Endpoint margins therefore certify the candidate's worst-case cost against the reference; pointwise interior dominance is not inferred.
profile_source: Experiment 9 global payment certificate; selected single feasible projection is the contractual reference; no endpoint-specific refit or post-hoc profile selection
certificate_scope: worst-case interval cost bound; finite q10/q50/q90 pointwise payment dominance remains the contractual guarantee

payment_value_interval.candidate_hull: two-endpoint segment between validation-frozen reference and payment-certified profiles
payment_value_interval.counterfactual_source: trace-observed event load, used only for independent settlement scoring
